headline_seed: Mass trial for 486 alleged gang members begins in El Salvador
description_seed: Footage released by the attorney general's office shows large groups of men in prison attending the trial via video link.

what: Mass trial for 486 alleged gang members begins in El Salvador

clean_source_blocks.text: Footage released by the attorney general's office shows large groups of men in prison attending the trial via video link.
A mass trial of 486 suspected MS-13 gang members has begun in El Salvador, the country's attorney general's office has said.
Members of Mara Salvatrucha, also known as MS-13 gang, attend a mass trial via video link. (Reuters: Attorney General of El Salvador)
Hundreds of alleged members of the Central American gang Mara Salvatrucha (MS-13) have gone on trial collectively in El Salvador.
